description: This file defines the SliceFixture class used for integration testing in an ASP.NET Core application. It manages database setup using in-memory database, dependency injection, and provides utility methods for executing scoped actions and sending requests via MediatR during tests.

classes.name: SliceFixture
classes.description: A utility class for setting up and managing a test environment including in-memory database and dependency injection for integration tests.
